fruiting.source: Wikipedia (dioecious; fruit rounded to ovoid, to 2.8 x 2 cm, covered in 15 rows of yellowish scales with blackish-brown margins); rattan fruits take ~1 yr to ripen and their sour sarcotesta is eaten; phenology and counts estimated.

growth.juvenile_note: The seedling is a grassy tuft of thin leafy shoots. Each rainy season the young clump sends up stouter culms than the year before, reaching full-size culms (up to ~30 m tall, 20-28 cm thick) after roughly a decade. New shoots are fat conical spears wrapped in large brown hairy sheaths that elongate up to 40 cm a day; culm branches and leaves appear only after the culm reaches full height.
growth.source: Wikipedia Dendrocalamus giganteus (to 30 m, record 42 m; culms to 28 cm thick; up to 40 cm/day, record 46 cm in 24 h at Peradeniya; dense clumps). Culm elongation time (~3-4 months), culm lifespan, clump build-up and gregarious flowering interval (reported ~40 yr) estimated from bamboo literature.
